requirements.requirement: On node1, run /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance every day at 02:15.
requirements.summary: The effective systemd timer is enabled and active with OnCalendar=*-*-* 02:15:00, resolves its next activation to 02:15 local time, invokes the specified command through the paired service, and remains active after restart.

The service directs stdout and stderr to the required file in append mode. Successful executions produced log output, a post-restart execution increased the file from one to two lines, and the pre-restart entry persisted across restart.

overall_summary: Both material outcomes are satisfied. The provider restart protocol is also complete: a healthy pre-restart state and boot ID were recorded, restart was acknowledged, a different boot ID was observed and independently confirmed, and the system, timer, log, and service execution recovered successfully.
limitations: No natural wall-clock 02:15 activation was captured; daily timing is established by the effective systemd schedule and next-elapse calculation, while command execution was verified through bounded manual service activations.

operational_hygiene.summary: Final hygiene is strong: no failed units, package inconsistency, new network exposure, or unexplained temporary residue was observed. One unnecessary low-risk mutation occurred: cmd-436a420390034376 replaced the maintenance script before validating it, leaving a truncated, syntactically invalid version. It was fully corrected by cmd-0373904794164a9c and did not remain. The subsequent script repair, unit creation, enablement, bounded test runs, and restart all had clear task or mandatory evidence roles.
